permitted_excerpts.text: The standard refund request window is thirty days after purchase.
Acme annual-plan purchases are an exception with a seven-day refund request window.
Acme monthly plans retain the standard thirty-day window.
Refund requests on the last day of the window are eligible.
Meeting rooms can be booked through the building calendar. This facilities reference does not define product behavior or customer commitments.
Office visitors check in at reception.
